# -http accepts a bare port or a host and port.
md2html -http :9034 test.md &
wait-port :9034
curl -s http://localhost:9034/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

md2html -http 127.0.0.1:9035 test.md &
wait-port :9035
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9035/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

# -v still serves pages.
md2html -v -http :9037 test.md &
wait-port :9037
curl -s http://localhost:9037/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

# -open does not launch a browser when MD2HTML_NO_BROWSER is set.
env MD2HTML_NO_BROWSER=1
md2html -open -http :9038 test.md &
wait-port :9038
curl -s http://localhost:9038/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

-- test.md --
# Test Document
